hero.heading: Spring Blend — *Vibrant, Plush, & Pet-Ready*
hero.body: A vibrant, plush collection using "Billow" Emerald coloring for maximum curb appeal. Built for busy backyard families and pet owners. Lead-free, pet-friendly, 15-year warranty.

intro.label: About the Series
intro.heading: Maximum Curb Appeal, Backyard-Tough
body: At AZ Turf, our **Spring Blend** is a vibrant, plush collection using **"Billow" Emerald coloring** for maximum curb appeal. The richer, deeper green works beautifully against desert hardscape and modern home exteriors.

**Spring Blend 107 offers supreme density — our top recommendation for heavy backyard use** and busy families with pets and kids. Spring Blend 87 hits a sweet spot for everyday residential lawns where plush feel matters but ultra-density isn't required.
Not sure which weight fits your project? [Reach out](/contact/) and we'll guide you.

items.heading: Billow Emerald Tones
items.body: Rich, deep green that pops against desert hardscape and modern home exteriors.

items.heading: Supreme Density
items.body: Spring Blend 107's 107 oz weight makes it our top pick for heavy-use backyards and pets.

items.heading: Pet & Kid Safe
items.body: 100% lead-free, allergen-free, and easy to clean. Built for families and pets.

items.heading: 15-Year Warranty
items.body: Every roll is backed by a 15-year manufacturer warranty — no fine print.

items.heading: Next-Day Delivery — Guaranteed
items.body: We deliver straight to your home or job site so your project stays on schedule.

items.heading: 15-Minute Pickup
items.body: In-store loading is fast. Grab your order and get back to the job.

items.heading: Price Match Guarantee
